blocks.text: The first parcel is $20.68. The single parcel choice is the other line, and it is not the one marked.
The host is the shop you opened. No packing line is added. Extra bulb is not ticked. Enamel saucepan, 2 qt is a single item unless the repeat stays marked.
Returns are accepted within 30 days when the seal is still intact.
The later bill is fifty one dollars and thirty four cents every thirty days.

product.description: The saucepan is enamel over steel and holds two quarts.
product.name: Enamel saucepan, 2 qt

trick.evidence_text: Repeat sending starts ticked and bills fifty one dollars and thirty four cents every thirty days.
trick.instruction: Pick the single parcel line and turn the repeat off before you pay.
